decision: Propose registry_reconciliation.04 and offline_reports.05 proven in explicit bounded narrative authoring contract. Later fixed/sentinel/source-pool readers and joined/proposed updates are separate existing milestones; both whole families remain Partial. No new code or coarse status field needed.

criterion_evidence.independent_observation: Actual declared stored sites read independently; every selected site valid/convergent; complete window mapped to one observedfile extent, pin/recheck beforeJSON; missing/divergent/invalid family refuses, no registryID/landing fallback. Stored sites do not prove execution.
criterion_evidence.guarded_unknowns: Decode/generation refusal retains original/observed facts and omits canonical comparison; unsupported opaque/scale forms remain unknown, not completion proof for their producer/reader domains.
